title: #276 Movies
prompt: Movies are popular all over the world. Explain why movies are so popular.

promptSegments.text: Movies are popular all over the world.
Explain why movies are so popular.

hardVocabulary.enGloss: A key word in this prompt.

requirements.en: Answer every direct question in the prompt.
requirements.vi: Trả lời mọi câu hỏi trực tiếp trong đề.

requirements.en: State a clear and consistent position when an opinion is requested.
requirements.vi: Nêu quan điểm rõ ràng và nhất quán khi đề yêu cầu ý kiến.

requirements.en: Develop each main idea with explanation and an example.
requirements.vi: Phát triển mỗi ý chính bằng giải thích và ví dụ.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Movies provide entertainment and a break from reality.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Movies provide entertainment and a break from reality.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Movies help people feel connected to others and build bonds.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Movies help people feel connected to others and build bonds.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Movies provide a means of escapism, allowing viewers to temporarily leave their daily problems and feel wonder and relaxation.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Movies provide a means of escapism, allowing viewers to temporarily leave their daily problems and feel wonder and relaxation.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Movies facilitate cultural connection and learning by showing viewers life in different places and cultures.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Movies facilitate cultural connection and learning by showing viewers life in different places and cultures.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Movies offer escapism and immersive storytelling, allowing viewers to temporarily leave mundane realities and explore alternative worlds, providing psychological respite.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Movies offer escapism and immersive storytelling, allowing viewers to temporarily leave mundane realities and explore alternative worlds, providing psychological respite.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Movies connect people through shared emotional experiences, creating communal events that strengthen social bonds and serve as a powerful social adhesive.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Movies connect people through shared emotional experiences, creating communal events that strengthen social bonds and serve as a powerful social adhesive.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not ignore a direct question in the prompt.
promptTraps.vi: Không bỏ qua câu hỏi trực tiếp trong đề.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionEn: How many main ideas should I use?
faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh câu chung học thuộc và mọi ý không trả lời đúng yêu cầu.

modelPlan.focus: Explore the universal appeal of movies through various aspects such as entertainment, storytelling, and cultural impact.
keyArguments: Movies provide a form of escapism and entertainment that appeals to a wide demographic.
The art of storytelling in movies connects audiences on an emotional level.
The cultural reach of movies transcends borders, making them a global phenomenon.
